text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It's been some time since I became a<n>trainer at
Tracen Academy, but I still<n>have no trainee—heck, I
haven't even<n>attempted to scout anyone.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Not for a lack of talent, of course.<n>Every student
here is packed with<n>potential. But whenever I think
about<n>scouting a runner, something always<n>holds
me back...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: I see. Well then, if I may offer someadvice... perhaps what you need to dois think outside the box?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
That's right! ♪ As I'm sure you<n>know, the Twinkle
Series isn't the<n>only race series Umamusume run
in!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Each region of Japan also holds its<n>own
independent series, and the<n>racers there compete
just as fiercely<n>as those in national races.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
In the past, we've had trainers find<n>real talented
racers in the regionals.<n>We've simply transferred
them to<n>Tracen Academy so they could sign a
contract.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Seeing as there's a race today in Oi, I<n>decide to
head over to see what their<n>racers are made of.
However...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The confusion that comes with<n>navigating a new
area is one thing,<n>but on top of that...

text_block_list.name: Fiesty Stray Cat
text_block_list.text: MRRRAOW!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: I encounter an absolute beast of acat, who apparently decided I'd makethe perfect prey! After a long, longgame of cat and mouse...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Gurgle...

Bwahahahaha! Whoa-ho there, you<n>good? Ya look
like you're bouta keel<n>over!

text_block_list.name: Fiesty Stray Cat
text_block_list.text: Mrrraow...

text_block_list.name: Fearless Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Well, if it isn't our resident<n>furball... What's
that? This stranger<n>was trespassin' on your turf?

text_block_list.name: Fearless Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Aw c'mon, lay off, will ya? This<n>stranger didn't
know any better. How<n>about ya let 'em go, huh?
Good kitty,<n>kitty, kitty!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume fearlessly reaches<n>out and pets
the hissing menace. In<n>an instant, the ferocious
feline<n>transforms into a tame housecat! This<n>is... the
work of a master cat<n>whisperer!

text_block_list.name: Fiesty Stray Cat
text_block_list.text: Meeeeeow! ♪

text_block_list.name: Fearless Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
All right, catch ya later! So... guessin'<n>this is your
first time here? Locals<n>don't usually get bullied by
the cats<n>or wander 'round like lost, hungry<n>kids.

text_block_list.name: Fearless Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Lucky for you, you ran into me!<n>Lemme show ya to
the tastiest soba<n>place in town!
choice_data_list: You'd do that for me? But we just met...
You'd do that for me? But we just met...

text_block_list.name: Fearless Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
So what? Leavin' people in need high<n>and dry's
not my style. Now c'mon,<n>let's get you some
noodles!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
With that, the fearless Umamusume<n>leads me to the
local shopping district.<n>She walks with such
confidence, I<n>almost think she owns the place!

text_block_list.name: Soba Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Well, well, well, if it isn't li'l Inari!<n>How would ya
like some fried tofu?<n>I've got plenty to go around!

text_block_list.name: Fearless Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Oh, might needa take ya up on that!<n>But before that,
I brought ya a<n>customer! Can ya get 'em some
soba?

text_block_list.name: Soba Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Ah, welcome! Hehe, since Inari<n>brought you, I better
treat you right!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Sure enough, the soba I order comestopped with not one, but two shrimptempura—a welcome surprise for myempty stomach!

text_block_list.name: Fearless Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
That soba really slaps, right? This<n>joint's the best
in town! ...By the<n>way, whatcha doing in our neck of
the<n>woods, anyway?

text_block_list.name: Fearless Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
If it's a guide ya need, I'm your Uma!<n>I know these
streets like the back of<n>my hand. So let's hear
it—where ya<n>headed?
choice_data_list: Well, I was trying to go to Oi Racecourse...

text_block_list.name: Fearless Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Hm? Did you just say... Ahahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Fearless Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Talk about good timin'! That's where<n>I'm headed
after this!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
With my trusty guide's help, I<n>successfully make it
to Oi Racecourse.<n>It looks like I'm just in time to
see<n>the local tryout races.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Woooo!

text_block_list.name: Fearless Umamusume
text_block_list.text: HRRRAUGH! GET OUTTA MY WAAAY!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Who would've guessed I'd see her<n>in the tryouts
today! But more<n>importantly!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
At long last, the final straight! Kicking<n>into high gear
and leaving a cloud of<n>dust in her wake is none
other than<n>Inari One! Inari One!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Time to pull out... THE FINISHER!<n>Urrraaaaaugh!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Inari One! Inari One takes the lead by<n>two, no, three
lengths and growing!<n>She's got this! Inari One...

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Crosses the finish line! Inari One has<n>won her
tryout race by four whole<n>lengths! That little body of
hers really<n>packs a punch! A flawless victory!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
As I suddenly gasp for air, I realize... I<n>was so
enthralled by her race that I<n>forgot to breathe.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
A heart-pounding performance, a run<n>powerful
enough to shake the very<n>earth... that competitive
spirit that<n>blazes like the festival fireworks, and<n>the
speed to leave even the sand<n>glistening...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I can tell from that race alone that<n>she's got what it
takes for turf<n>races—for the Twinkle Series! She's
the one! I... I...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, sorry, but no. I appreciate the<n>offer, but I
can't take ya up on that.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
After the race, I rushed over to Inari<n>One to give her
my pitch. While she<n>was kind enough to hear me
out, her<n>answer comes quickly and firmly.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
You can probably tell by now, but I<n>was born and
raised in this town! The<n>people here are like
family—they've<n>been watchin' over me since I was
a<n>teeterin' tot!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: And that includes my racin'. Mytrainer—Chief practically raised me,and I wanna make it big on his team.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Plus, well...

text_block_list.name: Racer with Purple Scrunchie
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I finally found you, Inari! Congrats<n>on the win! I,
uh... I ended up in fifth,<n>so I guess my stamina still
needs<n>some work...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, lighten up! All that hard<n>work gotcha onto
the scoreboard,<n>didn't it? Besides, pretty sure the
old<n>man has already scouted ya, right?

text_block_list.name: Racer with Purple Scrunchie
text_block_list.text: Yeah! And now I'm gonna be on thesame team as the Inari One! Icouldn't be happier! I can't wait to train with you!

text_block_list.name: Racer with Purple Scrunchie
text_block_list.text:
Oh, but I'm interrupting your<n>conversation, aren't I?
I'll let you get<n>back to it!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Okay, catch ya later! ...I think that<n>convo explains
things better than I<n>could.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I'm an Edo girl through and through. I<n>don't wanna
leave my teacher and all<n>my teammates behind...
Sorry 'bout<n>that!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: ...Aw, c'mon, ya look like a deflatedballoon. Cheer up, ya clearly got aneye for talent!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
You'll find a trainee at Tracen in no<n>time. I mean,
that place is famous for<n>its crazy talented students,
ri—
choice_data_list:
I couldn't find anyone at the school. Sure,
everyone's talented, but...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: But... what?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Ah, well... I-is that so? Uhhhh...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
You... know the way back, right? Try<n>not to get
cornered by the furball this<n>time. Anyway, uh...
thanks for comin'!
